schema_extensions.name: locations
schema_extensions.extraction_prompt: Carefully extract ALL locations from the ACORD 130 form text. This MUST include: (1) Primary locations from the 'LOCATIONS' table (e.g. Page 1, Loc #1, 2, 3), AND (2) ALL additional locations from any 'ADDITIONAL LOCATIONS' sections or attached schedules (e.g. Page 5, Loc #4, 5, 6, 7, 8 etc., including any TBD entries). For each location, extract: loc_number (integer), location_type ('PRIMARY' if from main LOCATIONS table, 'ADDITIONAL' if from ADDITIONAL LOCATIONS table), highest_floor (string or empty), street (full street address), city (string), county (string), state (2-letter code), zip (string), operations (any specific business operations or remarks noted for this location, or empty string). Return a JSON array of objects with keys: loc_number, location_type, highest_floor, street, city, county, state, zip, operations.

schema_extensions.name: contact_information
schema_extensions.extraction_prompt: From the insurance form text below, extract the CONTACT INFORMATION table. It has three rows: INSPECTION, ACCTNG RECORD (or ACCOUNTING RECORD), and CLAIMS INFO (or CLAIMS INFORMATION). For each row extract: type (the row label), name, office_phone, mobile_phone, email. Return a JSON object with keys: inspection, acctng_record, claims_info — each containing an object with keys: name, office_phone, mobile_phone, email. If a field is blank write empty string.

schema_extensions.name: report_metadata
schema_extensions.extraction_prompt: From the Loss Run report header, metadata, or footer in the text below, extract the report generation date, report valuation/evaluation date, and carrier name. Different insurance carriers label this differently, for example: 'Today's Date', 'Date Produced', 'Report Valuation Date', 'Valued as of', 'Date Printed', 'Report Date', or 'Date:'. Extract: (1) report_created_date: the date the report was produced, generated, or printed (string in MM/DD/YYYY format, or as written in document), (2) valuation_date: valuation or evaluation as-of date (string in MM/DD/YYYY format. MUST duplicate the value if identical to report_created_date. If no explicit valuation date is present, fallback to using the report_created_date), (3) carrier_name: name of the insurance carrier or company issuing the report, (4) date_label_found: the exact label found in the document (e.g. 'Today's Date', 'Report Valuation Date', 'Date Produced', 'Valued as of', 'Date:'). Return a JSON object with keys: report_created_date, valuation_date, carrier_name, date_label_found. If a field is completely missing and has no fallback, return empty string.
